messages.content: Hi, I'm having trouble logging into my account. It keeps saying my password is incorrect.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble logging in. Let me help you with that. Can you confirm the email address associated with your account?

Thank you. I can see your account. It looks like your account was temporarily locked due to multiple failed login attempts. I've unlocked it for you. Please try resetting your password using the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page.
Great! I was able to reset my password and log in successfully. Thank you so much!
My order hasn't arrived yet and it's been 5 days. The tracking shows it's stuck in transit.
I apologize for the delay with your order. Let me look up your tracking information. Can you provide your order number?

I see the issue. Your package is delayed due to weather conditions in the shipping hub. I'll expedite a replacement order for you at no charge, and it should arrive within 2 business days. You'll receive a tracking number shortly.
That's perfect, thank you for the quick resolution!
